newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - April 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - April 15.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its business section on April 15:
WASHINGTON - The U.S. government's two top trade negotiators with China said they were planning to leave the government in early summer to spend more time with their families.

WASHINGTON - Hillary Rodham Clinton earned nearly $750,000 in royalties last year from her best-selling book, "It Takes a Village," pushing the first family's total income over the $1 million mark for the first time.
WASHINGTON - The Clinton administration proposed a long list of changes in tax laws designed to make return-filing easier.
WASHINGTON - Hi-Gear Auto Tire and Auto Supply Inc. said it is liquidating and closing its 36 stores.
